name: Litmos LMS
summary: A cloud learning platform for workforce, customer and partner capability, with compliance management, content authoring, assessments, reporting and AI-enabled features.

value: 50+ out-of-the-box integrations including Workday, ADP, BambooHR, Salesforce, Teams, Zoom, Okta, Entra ID, Go1

value.notes: Platinum from US$15,000 a year; Platinum AI is quoted.

security.finding: Litmos publishes SOC 2 Type II 12-month audit (1 Apr 2024–31 Mar 2025), audited by Aprio, no exceptions noted. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate scope includes Litmos LMS, Litmos Training Ops and supporting cloud/corporate functions; certificate issued Jan 2025.
